'''Rod Latham Profit Or Die''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls138.htm Profit Or Die], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040107123318/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls138.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]

* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This
